attack_success_rate.scope_note: Measured at the RETRIEVAL-CONTAINMENT stage: whether a poisoned document reaches the analyst, not whether it changed the generated answer. Generation is not yet in this loop. Recompute end to end against the attacker's intended answer once it is.
attack_success_rate.matched_comparison_note: At the baseline's own false-block rate (96.2% of clean documents), the fusion score reaches ASR 0.800 versus the baseline's 0.000. This is the fair comparison; the operating-point figures above are not, because the two block at very different rates.
